title: Bridgewager Assoc.
tagline: Bridgewager Associates is an agentic hedge fund that specializes in prediction markets
description:
Bridgewager Associates is a sophisticated, agentic multi-agent hedge fund specializing in prediction markets. This cutting-edge financial technology project combines AI agents, blockchain technology, and prediction market trading into a comprehensive, autonomous investment platform.

The monorepo operates as a fully automated hedge fund where specialized AI agents perform roles traditionally filled by human professionals:

> Research Analysts: Conduct market analysis and generate trading recommendations.
> Portfolio Managers: Oversee investment strategy and coordinate the workflow between other agents.
> Execution Traders: Execute trades efficiently based on research-driven recommendations.
> Compliance Officers: Monitor risk parameters and ensure regulatory compliance.
how_its_made:
--- TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE ---
> Monorepo (Turborepo): Next.js 15 (Web), NestJS (API), Shared Packages.
> AI Agent System (LangChain/LangGraph): Research, Execution, and Manager agents coordinate via a supervised workflow with stateful memory.
> Blockchain/Market Integration: Trades on Polymarket CLOB, with wallets and transactions on Base (L2) via Coinbase CDP SDK using USDC.

--- KEY FEATURES ---
> Multi-Agent Workflow: Manager -> Analyst -> Trader -> Manager review loop.
> Real-Time Analysis: Fetches Polymarket data, calculates EV and Kelly criterion for position sizing.
> Research System: AI-generated reports using NewsAPI, stored via Tusky SDK.
> Interactive Dashboard: Tracks portfolio metrics (NAV, P&L), agent performance, and risk.
> Data Visualization: Real-time charts for performance, correlation heatmaps, etc.

--- TECH STACK ---
> Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
> Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, LangChain, Supabase.
> Integrations: Azure OpenAI, Polymarket CLOB, Coinbase CDP, NewsAPI, Tusky.

--- BUSINESS MODEL & INNOVATION ---
An autonomous hedge fund using AI to trade prediction markets.
> Differentiators: Fully autonomous trading, specialized focus on prediction markets, multi-agent coordination, and a transparent, blockchain-native foundation.
